attributes.law_screen: Fetched laws --tag core-screen --full 1 (17 records) before the first edit, plus the two named boundary laws from the work claim (typed-member-access-escapes-to-call-cse, offsetof-rename-can-regress-prior-improved-fn) and attempt.critterinitheader-record-reconstruction.20260830.v1/attempt.critter-defakematch-tu-pass.20260830.v3 in full via one batch `record` call. claim.law.offsetof-rename-preserves-protected-web: PRIMARY technique throughout -- every conversion kept the original raw u8*/void* base pointer type, spelling displacements as offsetof(Type,field) (or a compile-time sum/difference of offsetof/sizeof terms, see new law) added to that same pointer; zero typed intermediates introduced. claim.law.declared-alias-vs-repeated-cast / claim.law.multifield-alias-defeats-indexed-addressing / claim.law.lwzu-idiom-web-retention / claim.law.pointer-walk-array-index-regression / claim.law.recomputed-index-array-form-safe: heeded -- no walked or multi-field-touching base pointer was given a typed alias or converted to array-indexed form (CritterAddAnimInsts's `node` walk, CritterInitColnodes's `record`/`descriptor` walk, CritterDoSfx's hitnode-scan `node` all stayed raw u8* with offsetof-computed displacements). claim.law.offsetof-rename-array-member-boundary: informed caution -- never introduced a `->field+N` on an array-typed struct member reached via `->` decay. claim.law.typed-member-access-escapes-to-call-cse: screened per site -- every CritterDamageDef/descriptor conversion used offsetof-on-the-raw-byte-pointer even where the pointer was passed by value to a call in the same scope (CritterAnimInterrupt's `desc` reaching CritterFirePlayerCollide/CritterNodePlayerCollide/CritterDamagePlayer), never the already-typed-pointer member-access form the law warns against. sites (e.g. gCurLevel occurrences) that happened to fall inside one of those function bodies. claim.law.offsetof-fused-immediate-counter / claim.law.walked-base-symbol-identity / claim.law.scalar-read-write-lfsu-mixed-form / claim.law.dead-offset-shadow-removal-safe / claim.law.dead-offset-shadow-removal-needs-isolated-accumulator / claim.law.offsetof-rename-isolated-site-outlier / claim.law.offsetof-overturns-typed-alias-caps / claim.law.large-fn-batch-fuzzy-can-mask-subfield-regression / claim.law.write-site-alias-defeats-reload-parity / claim.law.swap-loop-is-record-layout-ground-truth: considered, none of their specific trigger shapes (dead shadow variable, dual-symbol overlap,
